thread:
elaine: FYI opened a docs PR for Dedicated provisioning tweaks -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420 :eyes:
elaine: TL;DR: clarify SLA language for reserved pools, add autoscale cooldown section, and a short note about tenant isolation during eviction. Added TODO for tiny SDK snippets (terraform + python).
ben: skimmed. nit: SLA phrasing on burst capacity sounds like bursts bypass isolation. can we explicitly state bursts still honor tenant isolation?
amara: I can take the SDK snippets. prefer both terraform and python?
elaine: yes both. terraform for infra, python for app/platform. keep them tiny. aim to land today if CI is green.
amara: draft terraform snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_scale_policy" "example" {
  tenant_id         = "tenant-123"
  min_gpus          = 1
  max_gpus          = 8
  cooldown_seconds  = 300 # prevents thrash after bursts
  preemption_policy = "notify-and-drain"
}
```
amara: and 2-line python SDK example:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.set_scale_policy(tenant_id="tenant-123", min_gpus=1, max_gpus=8, cooldown_seconds=300, preemption_policy="notify-and-drain")
```
lisa: can we add recommended preemption_policy options in a footnote and call out SLA impact (drain vs immediate)?
ben: also add a migration blurb for legacy `scaleCooldown` key — some infra automation uses the old name.
suresh: I'll draft migration snippet and push link fix: current handbook link in PR points to /handbook/provisioning which 404s. I can update to /handbook/dedicated/provisioning.
elaine: please push the link fix @suresh and add migration note under "Config migration".
suresh: pushed small commit: link fix + migration paragraph explaining key rename and a jq example to transform existing JSON/YAML.
docs-bot: doc build passed for branch docs/pr-1420 (lint: ok, links: 1 warn)
elaine: assigning reviewers @ben and @lisa, tagging @oncall. will merge after quick review. :shipit:
ben: quick review done, left one inline about wording and a tiny formatting nit.
amara: addressed nit, added footnote listing `notify-and-drain`, `immediate` and `best-effort` and their SLA implications. updated PR.
elaine: merging in 10 if no objections. cc: @support — this change is docs-only but note wording might prompt customers to ask about preemption behavior.
lisa: ack. small ask: add changelog line that this is documentation-only (no runtime change).
elaine: added changelog entry and merged.
notes: Coordination thread for docs PR 1420: SLA wording, autoscale cooldown/cooldown migration, tenant isolation clarification, small SDK snippets for terraform+python, link fix, and changelog. Contains inline code blocks and bot confirmation; short practical Slack-style messages.
